# Contributing

## External contributions are currently closed

This repository is publicly inspectable for transparency, evaluation, and discussion, but EvoCortexAI is **not accepting external code, policy, specification, or documentation contributions at this stage**.

Please do not open pull requests proposing changes to the canonical ethics source, executable controls, schemas, implementation, or documentation. Unsolicited pull requests may be closed without review and do not acquire normative standing, approval, or an implied license by being submitted.

If GitHub Issues are enabled, factual bug reports and questions may be submitted there. Security vulnerabilities must follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) and should not be disclosed in a public issue.

EvoCortexAI will publish an updated contribution policy when the Phase B gates in [`docs/PUBLIC-RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md`](../docs/PUBLIC-RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md) are complete, including outbound licensing, inbound contribution terms, public-safe CI, governance, and trademark/non-endorsement rules.

Internal maintainers continue to follow [`GOVERNANCE.md`](../GOVERNANCE.md) and the approved [`docs/ETHICS-RULES.md`](../docs/ETHICS-RULES.md).
